description: Overrides ONLY — classification/lanes come from the platform policy (homelab .github/renovate-global.json, applied via RENOVATE_CONFIG_FILE; a repo needs no renovate.json to be classified). This file exists for two repo-specific constraints: (1) `ignorePaths` drops config:recommended's `**/tests/**` skip — tests/Dockerfile holds the playwright image, the lockstep's second member; without it Renovate never extracts that FROM and the group ships the pypi pin alone, CI-red by construction (#11, homelab docs/renovate.md: a stack's renovate.json owns extraction coverage). (2) the pypi `playwright` EXACT pin must match the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python image tag in tests/Dockerfile (browsers are baked into that image per version) — the two must never bump independently.

packageRules.description: playwright lockstep: the pypi pin + the playwright/python docker tag move as ONE grouped PR (all update types — grouping only; lane labels still come from the global rules).
